description: Record what a memory's source says when your work ALREADY took you there — never go verifying memories as a task, never guess an outcome. A FACT proven gone is retired at once; a conflicting one when you propose the correction with arroway_remember supersedes_id. On a FINDING, source_gone archives it and a conflict is corrected in place. Rules and decisions are only marked.

memory.description: The #handle from the read, or the full id.

note.description: Required for conflicts (what the source says) and source_gone (what proves removal).

outcome.description: source_gone = PROVEN removed (404, file deleted, record gone), never mere unavailability (timeout, login wall, outage). conflicts = the source says something different.

name: arroway_verify
title: Record what the source says
